title: CUI: native UI components for C
excerpt: About 190 native UI components for C, compiled to machine code with no browser or runtime inside. Windows, macOS, Linux and the web. A complete app is about 250 KB.
content_html:
About 190 components, compiled to machine code with no browser or runtime inside. Windows, macOS, Linux and the web, from one C99 codebase. A complete app is about 250 KB.

This site runs every component live, which needs JavaScript. The text of every page is here without it:

  • Getting started
  • Tutorial: build a to-do app
  • All components
  • Showcase
  • Example apps
  • Changelog
  • Source on GitHub
